HASHMAP_FOREACH (carrier, link->bound_to_links, i)
    hashmap_remove(link->bound_to_links, INT_TO_PTR(carrier->ifindex));
HASHMAP_FOREACH (carrier, link->bound_by_links, i)

if (link->network) {

        (void) hashmap_remove(master->bond_slaves, INT_TO_PTR(link->ifindex));
}
```
Reason:
These statements ensure that before the link is freed, it is properly removed from the `bond_slaves` of its master link. This prevents any invalid memory access that could occur if the freed link is accessed through the master link's `bond_slaves`, thus maintaining proper memory management and integrity of the data structures.
